public_rationale: The record establishes real changes, including a temporary Claude coding regression and a later increase in access limits. It does not establish broad deterioration in both quality and availability across the targeted services. A literal reading that counts improvements would make the forecast easier to satisfy, but would omit its surrounding warning. The evidence is insufficient for an overall supported, contradicted, or mixed judgment.
limitations: The elapsed horizon uses an explicitly interpretive six-month endpoint.
Provider disclosures establish specific changes but do not replace representative subscriber-level measurements.
Partial support and counterevidence concern different changes and do not settle the broad claim.

statement.excerpt: The product you pay for today will be materially different in its quality and availability in mere months.
statement.document_title: I Will Never Respect A Website

from_speaker: The product you pay for today
our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion identifies paid OpenAI and Anthropic services as the principal targets.
In context, the ordinary reading predicts deterioration in useful quality and access. The isolated sentence also permits a direction-neutral reading.
Material means a change large enough to affect ordinary tasks or usable access, rather than a cosmetic change.
I use six months after publication as a working interpretation of 'mere months'. October 14 is an evaluator-selected endpoint, not an explicit deadline supplied by Zitron.
The claim requires evidence about both quality and availability. A new model announcement alone does not establish either deterioration or its practical magnitude.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable task results and access records show material deterioration in both quality and usable availability of the paid services within the interpreted window.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative comparisons establish maintained or improved quality and access across the window, sufficiently broadly to contradict the predicted deterioration.
